title: HB2874 (2023 Regular): Relating to public safety.

other_topics: judicial-criminal-justice: SECTION 6 (new) — creates the general crime of domestic terrorism (attempting catastrophic harm), classifies it in the sentencing grid and bars probation in specified cases

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2023R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/HB2874/Introduced; sha256 14ff68b81d48508cb727a15328a026c12131af388965564dd6da01a6dddae4df)
provenance.note: As-filed text (introduced), no votes recorded. SECTION 1 adds definitions (ORS 166.210). Penalties are graded by prior convictions and by whether 10 or more frames or receivers are involved (SECTIONS 4, 5). SECTION 8 amends ORS 166.412 as amended by Measure 114 (chapter 1, Oregon Laws 2023), extending the permit-to-purchase and dealer check to unfinished frames or receivers. The domestic-terrorism crime in SECTION 6 does not require a gun; its no-probation clause refers to possession of 10 or more unserialized frames or receivers.
